source.data_source: Oracle: OpenFOAM v2412 simpleFoam + kOmegaSST, blockMesh 2D backstep + downstream channel ~44k cells (no addLayers, wall functions). M=0.128, Re_H=36000, U_ref=44.2 m/s, H=0.0127 m. 5000 simpleFoam iters.
source.ref_data_source: Driver, D. M. and Seegmiller, H. L., AIAA Journal 1985. NASA TMR distributes cp.expnew.dat (rev 2014-02-28) and cf.exp.dat (rev 2015-10-17). Canonical reattachment x/H = 6.26 +- 0.10; cp_min_in_recirc = -0.19; cf_recovery_at_xH_20 = 0.0020.
source.calibration_note: gt_value comes from the oracle (this repo's solve.sh), not Driver-Seegmiller. kOmegaSST on a coarse non-layered mesh gives a 20% short reattachment (oracle x/H=5.0 vs canonical 6.26), strongly over-predicts the suction in the recirc bubble (oracle Cp_min=-3.3 vs canonical -0.19 — under-resolved inflow BL combined with sharp corner gradient amplifies bubble suction), and gives a recovery Cf 4x the experiment (oracle 0.008 vs canonical 0.002 — recovery is faster on coarse mesh). Final Ux residual stalls at ~3e-3 because the shear-layer near-stall flow doesn't fully steady-converge on this mesh. T_good widened generously to admit similar-coarse runs; physics bounds wide enough to keep well-resolved RANS in physics gate.
source.calibration_run: 2026-05-11, dev container /work/backstep_work, manual run with sign-flipped Cf + x_min=2 detector filter
source.of_signconv_note: Cf = -2 tau_x / U_ref^2 (negate raw wallShearStress.x): positive=attached, negative=recirc. Reattachment detector filters out spurious step-corner zero crossings via x_min=2 H_STEP.

mesh_cell_count.description: Total cell count of the 2D backstep mesh
mesh_cell_count.T_good_source: Oracle blockMesh gives 43840 cells. T_good wide because TMR offers ~6k to 390k. physics_min=10k filters out under-resolved cases.

final_residual_U.description: Final residual of the momentum equation
final_residual_U.T_good_source: Oracle stalls at 3e-3 (kOmegaSST near-stall non-steadiness). T_good widened to 5e-3 to admit comparable kOmegaSST runs; agents using SA can reach 1e-5 and easily pass.

reattachment_length_xH.description: Lower-wall reattachment x/H from zero-Cf crossing downstream of the step (x_min=2 H_STEP filter excludes step-corner artifacts; x_max=15 H_STEP)
reattachment_length_xH.T_good_source: Oracle reattachment x/H = 5.0 (vs Driver-Seegmiller 6.26, oracle 20% short — characteristic of coarse non-layered mesh with kOmegaSST). T_good=1.0 (~20% of gt) covers similar-quality runs; physics_max=12 admits well-resolved oracles matching experiment.

cp_min_in_recirculation.description: Minimum (most negative) lower-wall Cp inside the bubble (over 0 <= x/H <= 6), shifted Cp convention with Cp_ref at x/H~40
cp_min_in_recirculation.T_good_source: Oracle Cp_min=-3.33 in the bubble (vs Driver-Seegmiller -0.19, oracle 17x deeper — under-resolved inflow BL displacement combined with step-corner singularity steepens the bubble suction). T_good=0.80 (~24% of |gt|) is wide for this strongly mesh-sensitive quantity; physics_max=0.0 ensures Cp_min is genuinely negative.

cf_recovery_at_xH_20.description: Lower-wall Cf at x/H = 20 in the recovery region, sign-corrected: positive=attached
cf_recovery_at_xH_20.T_good_source: Oracle Cf at x/H=20 = +0.008 (sign-corrected from raw wallShearStress.x). Driver-Seegmiller cf.exp.dat at x/H~20 = 0.0020. Oracle 4x recovery rate — coarse mesh accelerates BL recovery. T_good=0.0020 covers similar-quality runs.
